findings.finding: Depth0 returns root files only; depth1 returns nested files with root-relative paths and excludes imported/plugin-trash dirs.

Directory getChildren failure returns empty array, indistinguishable by return value from empty directory. Caller must use availability/diagnostic context before interpreting missing files. No deletion consequence tested.
Real AAA->BBB overwrite between two stat samples passes isFileStable because only positive equal sizes checked. Equal size/mtime hasFileChanged also false. Stability admission is not byte identity.
isFileStableWithRetry delayMs controls delay between retries; each isFileStable still waits hardcoded1000ms. Source-only no retry timing benchmark.
